u0: The agent has not yet held the matching door key on any move. The objective is to acquire that key and carry it on at least two different moves; holding it for the first time advances to the next stage.
u1: The agent has already held the matching door key on one move. One more distinct move while carrying that key remains before the holding requirement is satisfied; the first holding stays credited even if the key is later dropped.
u2: The matching door key has been held on at least two different moves, so the task requirement is satisfied. No further holding objective remains.
